options.title: Mumbai se seedha east chalo toh kahan pahunchoge? 🌏
options.first_line: मुंबई से सीधे पूरब चलते जाएँ, तो कहाँ पहुँचेंगे?
options.first_frame: India's map with Maharashtra already painted and a pin pulsing on Mumbai, a bright arrow starting to point east across the map.

options.title: Mumbai ki seedh mein duniya ka kaunsa bada shehar? 🌏
options.first_line: मुंबई की सीध में दुनिया का कौन-सा बड़ा शहर है?
options.first_frame: Mumbai's pin pulsing on a painted Maharashtra, India small on a world map with a long dotted line running off the right edge towards a question mark.

options.title: Mumbai ki line pakdo, kitne desh paar honge? 🌏
options.first_line: मुंबई की लाइन पकड़कर पूरब चलें, तो कितने देश पार होंगे?
options.first_frame: A glowing line leaving Mumbai's pin eastward across a painted Maharashtra, with an empty counter sign beside it waiting to count countries.

why: Everyone knows Mumbai, and asking which famous world city sits on its line is a real mystery you have to stay for; with the sound off the world map with a dotted line running to a question mark already shows the question.
